This document constitutes the Privacy Notice for the purposes set forth in the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties currently in force, as well as the provisions derived from or related to it. This Privacy Notice applies to the personal information collected about the Data Subject by Fertility Center Cancun, S.A.P.I. de C.V., in its capacity as the Data Controller.

1. DEFINITIONS:

For the purposes of this Notice and in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, the following terms shall be understood as:
a) Privacy Notice – A physical or electronic document generated by the Data Controller that is made available to the Data Subject prior to the processing of their personal data.
b) Personal Data – Any information concerning an identified or identifiable natural person.
c) Sensitive Personal Data – Those personal data that affect the most intimate sphere of the Data Subject, or whose misuse could result in discrimination or pose a serious risk to them.
d) ARCO Rights – Refers to the rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Objection that, in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and subject to the exceptions established therein and in this Privacy Notice, every Data Subject has in relation to the Personal Data collected by the Data Controller and/or its Processors, as described below:
i. Right of Access – This is the right of the Data Subject to know about the Personal Data related to them held by the Data Controller or its Processors, as well as to whom such data has been shared and for what purpose.
ii. Right to Rectification – Each Data Subject has the right to have their Personal Data rectified when it is inaccurate or incomplete.
iii. Right to Cancellation – Each Data Subject has the right to request at any time the deletion of their Personal Data. This will take place after a blocking period. Blocking implies the identification and preservation of Personal Data once the purpose for which it was collected has been fulfilled, with the aim of determining any potential liabilities related to its processing, up to the legal or contractual limitation period. During this period, the Personal Data shall not be subject to processing, and once it ends, the data will be deleted from the corresponding database or file. Once the data has been cancelled, the Data Controller shall notify the Data Subject accordingly. In the event that the Personal Data was previously transferred before the date of rectification or cancellation and is still being processed by third parties, the Data Controller shall inform such third parties of the request for rectification or cancellation so that they may also comply accordingly.
iv. Right of Objection – The Data Subject has the right at all times to request, provided there is a legitimate reason, that the Data Controller ceases the processing of their Personal Data.
e) Data Controller – Refers to the individual or legal entity that decides on the processing of the Data Subject’s Personal Data, in this case FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V.
f) Processor – Refers to the individual or legal entity that alone or jointly with others processes Personal Data on behalf of the Data Controller.
g) Data Subject – The natural person to whom the personal data belongs.

2. DATA SUBJECT’S CONSENT

The Data Subject shall be deemed to have tacitly consented to the processing of their data when, having been made aware of the Privacy Notice, they do not express their objection.
For the purposes of Article 17 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, the Data Subject declares that:
i. This Privacy Notice has been made known to them by the Data Controller.
ii. They have read, understood, and agreed to the terms set forth in this Privacy Notice, and therefore grant their consent to the processing of their Personal Data for purposes of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and other applicable legislation. In the event that the collected Personal Data includes sensitive or financial Personal Data, whether in printed format or using electronic means and their corresponding consent-forming processes—such as, but not limited to, the provision of Personal Data through dialogue boxes, or the viewing and scrolling through on-screen terms and conditions—these actions constitute the Data Subject’s express consent in accordance with the second paragraph of Article 8 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and other applicable laws.
iii. They grant their consent for FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V., or its Processors, to transfer Personal Data to national or foreign third parties, with the understanding that the processing such third parties give to their Personal Data must adhere to the provisions of this Privacy Notice.
If the Data Subject does not object to the terms of this Privacy Notice within 48 hours of it being made available to them, its content shall be deemed accepted and consented to, in accordance with the third paragraph of Article 8 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties. The Data Subject may revoke their consent at any time, without retroactive effects, in accordance with the terms and procedures set forth later in this Privacy Notice.
Notwithstanding any provision of this Privacy Notice, the Data Subject acknowledges that their consent will not be required for the processing of Personal Data by the Data Controller or third parties in any of the cases set forth in Article 10 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties.

3. PURPOSE OF THE PRIVACY NOTICE; PURPOSE OF PERSONAL DATA

This Privacy Notice aims to establish the terms and conditions under which FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V., or the Data Processor designated by FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V., whether through its website http://www.fertilitycentercancun.com.mx or within the facilities of FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V., will receive and protect the Data Subject's Personal Data, in order to safeguard their privacy and right to informational self-determination, in compliance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties; (ii) will use the Data Subject's Personal Data; and (iii) will, where applicable, transfer the Personal Data to third parties.
These purposes include, but are not limited to, the following:


1. Data Subject's Identifying Information:

i. Full name, age, place and date of birth, marital status, gender, city, country of residence, occupation, phone numbers, CURP, RFC, email address, and in the case of foreign nationals, immigration form (Temporary or Permanent Residence), national military service card (if applicable), among others.

ii. Proof of address: such as utility bills (water, property tax, or electricity), credit report issued by a credit reporting agency. In the case of job applicants, other documents may be requested such as birth certificate, academic transcripts, retirement fund account statement (AFORE), tax withholding form, medical records, and psychometric or socioeconomic assessments conducted by FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V.. Information about relatives, dependents, or beneficiaries may also be requested, including name, date of birth, address, phone number, and supporting documents such as birth or marriage certificates.

iii. The website http://www.fertilitycentercancun.com.mx and related services from FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. and its providers require cookies enabled in your internet browser for proper functioning. Cookies are small data files transferred by the website to your computer’s hard drive while browsing. Cookies can be session-based (deleted after the session ends) or persistent (remain on the device until deleted or expired).
Most browsers accept cookies automatically by default, but you may change your settings to allow or reject them. Disabling cookies may impair certain features of FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. websites or cause them to display incorrectly. If you prefer to delete cookies sent by FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V., you may do so at the end of each browsing session. Relevant information is available from the major internet browser providers.

iv. Use of web beacons (also known as internet tags, pixel tags, or clear GIFs): FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. may use web beacons on its websites and HTML-formatted emails, alone or in combination with cookies, to collect information about website usage and email interaction. A web beacon is a small electronic image (1x1 pixel or GIF) that can recognize data processed on your computer, such as cookies, and track the time and date that a website or its sections were viewed. Email links from FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. may include tracking functionality that lets the company know whether you clicked and visited the linked page, which may then be added to your profile.
v. Personal Data that FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. obtains from commercial sources may be used in combination with data collected through its websites.
The Data Controller may also collect Personal Data from public sources and from other market-available sources where the Data Subject may have consented to share their personal information, in order to carry out the following services:
i. Provision of medical and hospital services, including but not limited to hospitalization, surgery, diagnostic studies, nursing care, pharmaceutical services, blood bank services, hemodialysis, oncology treatments, laboratory analysis, radiology and imaging, pathological studies and analysis, therapy, rehabilitation, diet and nutrition, and other healthcare-related purposes.
ii. Creation, study, analysis, updating, and maintenance of the clinical file.
iii. Billing and collection for services rendered.
iv. Health information studies, records, statistics, and analysis.
v. Maintenance of records for service follow-up, future services, and ongoing monitoring of contractual relationships.
vi. Statistical and market analysis.


2. Sensitive Personal Data of the Data Subject:

i. Collection of clinical history, laboratory results, diagnoses or clinical conditions, family hereditary history, personal pathological history, allergies, restrictions, gamete donor status, emergency contact information, certificates issued by physicians or medical/health institutions, collectively referred to as “Sensitive Personal Data.” FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. does not collect or process “Sensitive Personal Data” through its website.


3. Physical Characteristics of the Data Subject:

i. Video recordings and/or photographs obtained through internal camera systems upon entering our facilities, skin, eye, and hair color, scars or distinguishing features, all of which fall under “Personal Data.”


4. Financial Data of the Data Subject:

i. Name of the account holder, financial institution, card number, security code, expiration date—all contained in credit and/or debit cards.
FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. may need to share your Personal Data with service providers for database management and administration, automated processing and storage of Personal Data, email authentication and validation, hiring services, auditing services, and other services of a similar nature.

 

4. TRANSFER OF DATA

Upon reading, understanding, and agreeing to the terms set forth in this Privacy Notice, the Data Subject expresses their consent for the Data Controller or any Data Processor to transfer Personal Data to national or foreign third parties, with the understanding that the treatment given to the Data Subject’s Personal Data by such third parties must adhere to the provisions established in this Privacy Notice.
The Data Subject acknowledges and accepts that the Data Controller does not require the Data Subject’s authorization or confirmation to carry out national or international transfers of Personal Data in the cases provided for under Article 37 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties or in any other exception provided by said law or other applicable legislation.


5. STORAGE AND SECURITY OF PERSONAL DATA

The Data Controller and/or its Data Processors will retain the Data Subject’s Personal Data for as long as necessary to process their requests for information, products, and/or services, and to maintain accounting, financial, and audit records in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and the applicable commercial, tax, and administrative legislation.
The Personal Data collected by the Data Controller and/or its Data Processors will be protected by appropriate administrative, technical, and physical security measures to prevent damage, loss, alteration, destruction, or unauthorized use, access, or processing, in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and its related administrative regulations.
Notwithstanding the above, FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. does not guarantee that unauthorized third parties cannot gain access to the physical or logical systems of the Data Subject or the Data Controller, or to the electronic documents and files stored in such systems. Consequently, FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. shall not, under any circumstances, be held liable for any damages or losses resulting from such unauthorized access.
FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. may disclose your Personal Data to comply with applicable legal provisions or upon request of a competent authority, as well as to carry out the purposes for which the data were collected. Therefore, it may conduct national or international data transfers, and may also transfer data to service provider entities in order to fulfill the stated purposes, except for Sensitive Personal Data, which requires your express authorization to be disclosed, in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties.

6. PROCEDURE TO EXERCISE ARCO RIGHTS

To exercise ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, or Opposition), the Data Subject or their legal representative must submit a written request for access, rectification, cancellation, or opposition, including the following information and documentation:
i. The name of the Data Subject and an address or other means to communicate the response to their request.
ii. Documents proving their identity (a simple copy, in printed or electronic format, of their voter ID, passport, or Temporary or Permanent Residency Card), or, if applicable, proof of legal representation (a simple copy, in printed or electronic format, of a power of attorney signed by the Data Subject and the representative, along with their respective official identifications: voter ID, passport, or Temporary or Permanent Residency Card).
iii. A clear and precise description of the Personal Data regarding which they seek to exercise any of the ARCO Rights.
iv. Any other element or document that facilitates the location of the Personal Data of the Data Subject.
In the case of requests for the rectification of Personal Data, the Data Subject must also indicate the modifications to be made and provide documentation supporting their request.
To receive, register, and process requests to exercise the rights of access, rectification, cancellation, and opposition to Personal Data, as well as to limit the use or disclosure of such data and to exercise other rights provided by the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, please contact:
Email address: direccion@fcc.com.mx
The Data Controller or its Processors will respond to the respective Data Subject within a maximum period of twenty business days from the date on which the request for access, rectification, cancellation, or opposition is received, informing them of the determination made so that, if appropriate, it may be enforced within fifteen business days following the date on which the response is communicated. In the case of requests for access to Personal Data, the Data Controller or its Processors will provide the information upon verification of the identity of the applicant or their legal representative, as applicable.
The aforementioned time periods may be extended only under the terms of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, in accordance with Article 32 of said law.
The delivery of Personal Data will be free of charge; the Data Subject will only be required to cover justified shipping costs or reproduction expenses for copies or other formats.
For requests regarding the cancellation of Personal Data, in addition to the provisions of this Privacy Notice, the terms of Article 26 of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties shall apply, including the exceptions to the cancellation of Personal Data outlined therein.


7. CHANGES TO THE PRIVACY NOTICE

FERTILITY CENTER CANCUN, S.A.P.I. DE C.V. reserves the right to periodically update this Privacy Notice in order to reflect changes in our information practices. It is the responsibility of the Data Subject to periodically review the contents of this Privacy Notice on the website www.fcc.com.mx.
The Data Controller will interpret that, unless otherwise expressly indicated, the Data Subject has read, understood, and agreed to the terms set forth, which constitutes their consent to the changes established in such updates regarding the processing of their Personal Data for the purposes of the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and other applicable legislation.

DE C.V.<\\/strong> and its providers require cookies enabled in your internet browser for proper functioning. DE C.V.<\\/strong> may use web beacons on its websites and HTML-formatted emails, alone or in combination with cookies, to collect information about website usage and email interaction. 6. PROCEDURE TO EXERCISE ARCO RIGHTS<\\/strong><\\/h3>

iv. Any other element or document that facilitates the location of the Personal Data of the Data Subject.

To receive, register, and process requests to exercise the rights of access, rectification, cancellation, and opposition to Personal Data, as well as to limit the use or disclosure of such data and to exercise other rights provided by the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties, please contact:

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we understand how important the journey to parenthood is. That's why we offer a comprehensive range of fertility treatments designed to meet the individual needs of each patient and couple. Our highly trained medical team and state-of-the-art facilities are at your service to provide you with the best care and the highest chances of success.

Personalized Treatments
Every patient is unique, and our treatments are designed to cater to your specific needs. Whether you're seeking a solution for infertility, hormonal issues, reproductive difficulties, or other reasons, we work with you to determine the right treatment.

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, our commitment is to provide you with effective solutions and support you with care and professionalism at every stage of your fertility treatment.

pages.post_content:
En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún trabajamos con un compromiso firme hacia la excelencia médica, la seguridad del paciente y la calidad en cada uno de nuestros procesos. Contamos con certificaciones y acreditaciones de organismos reconocidos, además de alianzas estratégicas con líderes en medicina reproductiva y tratamientos de fertilidad a nivel mundial.

Certificaciones y Membresías

Certificación PACAL – Excelencia en Calidad de Laboratorio

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún participamos activamente en el Programa de Aseguramiento de la Calidad para Laboratorios (PACAL), una de las evaluaciones externas más reconocidas en México para garantizar la calidad y confiabilidad de los resultados emitidos por los laboratorios clínicos.

Este programa nacional realiza controles de calidad externos y auditorías periódicas, permitiendo evaluar el desempeño técnico y analítico de cada área del laboratorio mediante ejercicios comparativos con cientos de instituciones en el país.

Gracias a nuestros resultados consistentes, nuestra clínica de fertilidad y reproducción asistida, Advanced Fertility Center Cancún ha sido reconocido por PACAL con un diploma que acredita la excelencia en calidad analítica en las siguientes áreas especializadas: Química clínica, Inmunología-Endocrinología y Citometría Hemática.

Contar con la certificación PACAL asegura a nuestros pacientes que los estudios que realizamos en sitio cumplen con estándares nacionales de excelencia, alineados con las mejores prácticas de calidad clínica en México.
Esto nos permite ofrecer a nuestros pacientes resultados confiables, diagnósticos precisos y atención médica respaldada por calidad certificada.

Cumplimiento con la FDA – Seguridad y Normativas Internacionales

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún cumplimos con las regulaciones establecidas por la U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), autoridad sanitaria de Estados Unidos encargada de proteger la salud pública mediante el control de medicamentos, productos biológicos y tejidos humanos utilizados en tratamientos médicos.

Este cumplimiento es especialmente relevante para nuestros pacientes internacionales que desean transportar óvulos, esperma o embriones hacia o desde los Estados Unidos, ya que garantiza que todos los procesos relacionados con la manipulación de tejidos reproductivos se realicen bajo estándares reconocidos a nivel mundial.

Gracias a estos protocolos, nuestros pacientes provenientes de Estados Unidos y Canadá pueden confiar en que nuestros procedimientos cumplen con las normativas de su país, facilitando una atención continua y segura, incluso cuando el tratamiento de fertilidad se inicia en México y concluye en otro destino.

Confianza internacional respaldada por regulaciones estrictas. En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, trabajamos bajo estándares FDA para brindarte seguridad en cada paso de tu tratamiento de fertilidad o reproducción asistida.

Acreditación del Canadian Health Council – Segundo Ciclo de Evaluación

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, nos enorgullece contar con la acreditación del Canadian Health Council, una de las entidades internacionales más rigurosas en la evaluación de calidad en servicios de salud. Actualmente, nos encontramos en el segundo ciclo de acreditación, lo que refleja nuestro compromiso continuo con la mejora, la excelencia médica y la atención centrada en el paciente.

Al alcanzar el segundo ciclo de acreditación, Advanced Fertility Center Cancún demuestra que no solo ha cumplido con los criterios iniciales, sino que ha sostenido e incrementado sus estándares a lo largo del tiempo, en una auditoría de seguimiento aún más estricta.

Estar acreditados por el Canadian Health Council brinda a nuestros pacientes internacionales —especialmente a quienes viajan desde Canadá y Estados Unidos— la tranquilidad de recibir tratamientos de fertilidad en una clínica que:

  • Cumple con estándares equivalentes a los de su país de origen.
  • Implementa protocolos de seguridad y calidad con enfoque internacional.
  • Tiene procesos claros y confiables para el manejo de gametos y embriones en viajes transfronterizos.

 

Confianza, transparencia y excelencia médica avalada por estándares internacionales.

Membresía ESHRE – Excelencia Europea en Medicina Reproductiva

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún somos miembros activos de la European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology (ESHRE), una de las organizaciones científicas más reconocidas a nivel mundial en el campo de la medicina reproductiva.

Fundada en Europa, ESHRE agrupa a clínicas,especialistas, embriólogos e investigadores comprometidos con la excelencia científica, la innovación y las mejores prácticas clínicas en tratamientos de fertilidad.

Conocimiento global, atención local. En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, tu tratamiento se respalda con los más altos estándares internacionales.

Certificación REDLARA (Red Latinoamericana de Reproducción Asistida) – Sello Dorado de Excelencia

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún contamos con la certificación oficial de la Red Latinoamericana de Reproducción Asistida (REDLARA), la organización más importante de reproducción asistida en América Latina. Esta acreditación no solo valida nuestros procesos clínicos y de laboratorio, sino que nos distingue con el Sello Dorado de Excelencia, otorgado exclusivamente a clínicas que cumplen con los más altos estándares de calidad, ética y efectividad en tratamientos de fertilidad.

Esta certificación es renovada periódicamente mediante auditorías presenciales realizadas por expertos internacionales en medicina reproductiva, lo que garantiza que mantenemos prácticas clínicas seguras, éticas y efectivas.

La acreditación por REDLARA es sinónimo de confianza, profesionalismo y compromiso con los pacientes. Solo un número selecto de clínicas en Latinoamérica ha obtenido el Sello Dorado, lo que posiciona a Advanced Fertility Center Cancún como un centro de excelencia en tratamientos de fertilidad y reproducción asistida a nivel regional e internacional.

AMMR – Compromiso con la Medicina Reproductiva Mexicana

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, nuestros especialistas forman parte activa de la Asociación Mexicana de Medicina de la Reproducción (AMMR), la principal organización nacional dedicada al desarrollo ético, científico y profesional de la medicina reproductiva en México.

Esta afiliación confirma que nuestro equipo médico se mantiene actualizado, comprometido con la mejora continua y en cumplimiento con los más altos estándares de atención clínica en fertilidad.

La excelencia médica comienza con la formación. En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, tu atención está en manos de especialistas certificados y comprometidos con los más altos estándares de la medicina reproductiva en México.

COMERGO – Comité Mexicano de Reproducción en Ginecología y Obstetricia

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, estamos orgullosos de contar con especialistas que forman parte del Comité Mexicano de Reproducción en Ginecología y Obstetricia (COMERGO), una organización nacional que agrupa a los expertos más reconocidos en medicina reproductiva en México.

COMERGO promueve la actualización científica, la ética profesional y la excelencia médica en el campo de la reproducción humana asistida, respaldando prácticas clínicas basadas en evidencia y con enfoque centrado en el paciente.

Formación, ética y excelencia médica respaldan cada historia de fertilidad. En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, trabajamos con compromiso y conocimiento especializado gracias a nuestra participación en COMERGO.

SECTUR – Distintivo de Salud

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, nos enorgullece contar con el Distintivo de Salud otorgado por SECTUR, la Secretaría de Turismo de México. Esta certificación reconoce nuestro compromiso con los más altos estándares de higiene, seguridad y calidad en la prestación de servicios de salud dentro del sector turístico.
El Distintivo de Salud de SECTUR se concede únicamente a las instituciones que cumplen de manera estricta con protocolos sanitarios diseñados para proteger tanto a pacientes como a visitantes, lo cual es especialmente relevante en el ámbito del turismo médico. Esta distinción refleja nuestra dedicación a ofrecer un entorno seguro, confiable y profesional para todos nuestros pacientes, en particular aquellos que viajan desde el extranjero para recibir tratamiento de fertilidad.
Contar con esta certificación es una garantía para nuestros pacientes de que en Advanced Fertility Center Cancún priorizamos su bienestar, cumpliendo con las normas nacionales y adoptando las mejores prácticas en seguridad sanitaria.

Confianza, seguridad y excelencia: la base de tu tratamiento con nosotros.

Alianzas Estratégicas

Igenomix – Genética Reproductiva Avanzada

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún colaboramos con Igenomix, uno de los laboratorios líderes a nivel mundial en genética reproductiva. Gracias a esta alianza, ofrecemos a nuestros pacientes pruebas especializadas como el diagnóstico genético preimplantacional (PGT-A), que permite identificar embriones con mayor potencial de implantación y reducir el riesgo de enfermedades genéticas.

Mayor precisión, mejores resultados y decisiones basadas en ciencia genética de vanguardia.

Unilab – Tamizaje y Análisis de Donantes con Estándares Internacionales

Contamos con el respaldo de Unilab, un laboratorio especializado en pruebas de tamizaje y análisis de donantes que cumple con las regulaciones de la FDA. Esta colaboración garantiza que todo el proceso de evaluación de donantes se realiza bajo estrictos protocolos de seguridad y calidad, esenciales para tratamientos con gametos donados.

Confianza y seguridad en cada muestra, con cumplimiento normativo internacional.

Cryotec – Tecnología de Vitrificación de Última Generación

Utilizamos la tecnología de Cryotec, líder mundial en vitrificación de óvulos y embriones, reconocida por sus altas tasas de supervivencia celular. Esta alianza nos permite ofrecer a nuestros pacientes una técnica de congelamiento ultrarrápida que protege al máximo la calidad y viabilidad de los gametos y embriones.

Tecnología japonesa de precisión para preservar tu fertilidad con los mejores resultados.

Red de Clínicas Asociadas en EE.UU. y Canadá

Formamos parte de una red internacional de clínicas asociadas en Estados Unidos y Canadá, lo que permite a nuestros pacientes continuar su tratamiento de fertilidad de forma fluida y segura entre países. Esta colaboración facilita el transporte de gametos y embriones, así como la coordinación de ciclos compartidos, consultas y seguimientos a distancia.

Atención internacional continua, sin fronteras ni interrupciones.

Ferticare – Apoyo Psicológico Especializado

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún contamos con una alianza con Ferticare, especialistas en psicología de la fertilidad, para brindar acompañamiento emocional durante todo el proceso reproductivo.
A través de esta colaboración, nuestros pacientes reciben apoyo profesional para manejar el estrés, la ansiedad y los desafíos emocionales propios de los tratamientos de fertilidad.

Cuidamos tu bienestar físico y emocional en cada etapa del camino.

Bancos Internacionales de Esperma y Óvulos – Opciones Globales para Nuestros Pacientes

En nuestra clñinica de fertilidad, Advanced Fertility Center Cancún contamos con alianzas estratégicas con reconocidos bancos internacionales de esperma y ovocitos, lo que nos permite ofrecer a nuestros pacientes una amplia variedad de opciones seguras, éticas y confiables para tratamientos con gametos donados.

Entre nuestros colaboradores se encuentran:

  • Xytex, Fairfax Cryobank, European Sperm Bank, Cryos International entre otros..

Estas alianzas permiten el acceso a catálogos internacionales, cumplimiento de normativas como FDA, Health Canada y estándares europeos, y facilitan la importación legal y segura de muestras hacia México.

Variedad, calidad y confianza para construir tu familia sin fronteras.

Compromiso con la calidad y la confianza

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we are firmly committed to medical excellence, patient safety, and quality in every one of our processes. We hold certifications and accreditations from recognized organizations, along with strategic partnerships with leaders in reproductive medicine worldwide.

Certifications and Memberships

PACAL Certification – Excellence in Laboratory Quality

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we actively participate in the Quality Assurance Program for Laboratories (PACAL), one of the most recognized external evaluations in Mexico that ensures the quality and reliability of results issued by clinical laboratories.
This national program conducts external quality controls and periodic audits, evaluating the technical and analytical performance of each laboratory area through comparative exercises with hundreds of institutions across the country.
Thanks to our consistent results, Advanced Fertility Center Cancún has been awarded a diploma by PACAL certifying excellence in analytical quality in the following specialized areas: Clinical Chemistry, Immunology-Endocrinology, and Hematology Cytometry.
Holding the PACAL certification assures our patients that the tests we perform on-site meet national standards of excellence, aligned with the best clinical quality practices in Mexico. Reliable results, precise diagnoses, and medical care backed by certified quality.

FDA Compliance – Safety and International Regulations

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we comply with regulations established by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the United States authority responsible for protecting public health through the regulation of drugs, biological products, and human tissues used in medical treatments.
This compliance is especially important for our international patients who wish to transport eggs, sperm, or embryos to or from the United States, as it guarantees that all processes related to the handling of reproductive tissues are carried out under globally recognized standards.
Thanks to these protocols, our patients from the U.S. and Canada can trust that our procedures meet their country’s regulations, facilitating continuous and safe care, even when treatment begins in Mexico and concludes elsewhere.
International trust supported by strict regulations. At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we operate under FDA standards to provide you safety at every step of your treatment.

Canadian Health Council Accreditation – Second Accreditation Cycle

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we take pride in holding accreditation from the Canadian Health Council, one of the most rigorous international entities for evaluating quality in health services. We are currently in the second accreditation cycle, reflecting our ongoing commitment to improvement, medical excellence, and patient-centered care.
Achieving the second accreditation cycle means Advanced Fertility Center Cancún has not only met the initial criteria but has maintained and elevated its standards over time under even stricter follow-up audits.
Being accredited by the Canadian Health Council gives our international patients—especially those traveling from Canada and the United States—the confidence that they will receive fertility treatments at a clinic that:

  • Meets standards equivalent to those in their home country
  • Implements safety and quality protocols with an international focus
  • Has clear and reliable processes for handling gametes and embryos during cross-border transport

 

Trust, transparency, and medical excellence endorsed by international standards.

ESHRE Membership – European Excellence in Reproductive Medicine

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we are active members of the European Society of Human Reproduction and Embryology (ESHRE), one of the most prestigious scientific organizations worldwide in the field of reproductive medicine.
Founded in Europe, ESHRE brings together specialists, embryologists, researchers, and clinics committed to scientific excellence, innovation, and best clinical practices in fertility treatments.

Global knowledge, local care. At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, your treatment is supported by the highest international standards.

REDLARA Certification (Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction) – Golden Seal of Excellence

Advanced Fertility Center Cancún holds official certification from the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction (REDLARA), the most important assisted reproduction organization in Latin America. This accreditation not only validates our clinical and laboratory processes but also distinguishes us with the Golden Seal of Excellence, awarded exclusively to clinics that meet the highest standards of quality, ethics, and effectiveness in fertility treatments.
This certification is renewed periodically through on-site audits conducted by international experts in reproductive medicine, ensuring we maintain safe, ethical, and effective clinical practices.
REDLARA accreditation is synonymous with trust, professionalism, and commitment to patients. Only a select number of clinics in Latin America have received the Golden Seal, positioning Advanced Fertility Center Cancún as a center of excellence in fertility treatments both regionally and internationally.

AMMR – Commitment to Mexican Reproductive Medicine

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, our specialists are active members of the Mexican Association of Reproductive Medicine (AMMR), the leading national organization dedicated to the ethical, scientific, and professional development of reproductive medicine in Mexico.
This affiliation ensures that our medical team stays updated, committed to continuous improvement, and compliant with the highest standards of clinical care in fertility.
Medical excellence begins with education. At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, your care is in the hands of certified specialists dedicated to the highest standards of reproductive medicine in Mexico.

COMERGO – Mexican Committee of Reproduction in Gynecology and Obstetrics

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we are proud to have specialists who are members of the Mexican Committee of Reproduction in Gynecology and Obstetrics (COMERGO), a national organization that brings together the most recognized experts in reproductive medicine in Mexico.
COMERGO promotes scientific updating, professional ethics, and medical excellence in the field of assisted human reproduction, supporting evidence-based clinical practices with a patient-centered focus.
Education, ethics, and medical excellence support every fertility story. At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we work with commitment and specialized knowledge thanks to our participation in COMERGO.

SECTUR – Health Distinction

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we are proud to have been awarded the Health Distinction (Distintivo de Salud) by SECTUR, the Secretariat of Tourism of Mexico. This prestigious certification recognizes our commitment to maintaining the highest standards of hygiene, safety, and quality in health services within the tourism sector.
The SECTUR Health Distinction is granted to facilities that demonstrate strict compliance with health protocols designed to protect patients and visitors, especially in the context of medical tourism. It reflects our dedication to creating a safe and trustworthy environment for all our patients, particularly those traveling internationally to receive fertility treatments.
By holding this distinction, Advanced Fertility Center Cancún assures patients that we prioritize their well-being by adhering to national guidelines and best practices in health and safety, reinforcing our role as a leading fertility clinic in Mexico welcoming patients from around the world.

Trust, safety, and excellence — the foundation of your fertility journey with us.

Strategic Alliances

Igenomix – Advanced Reproductive Genetics

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we collaborate with Igenomix, one of the world’s leading laboratories in reproductive genetics. Through this alliance, we offer our patients advanced testing such as Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidies (PGT-A), which helps identify embryos with the highest implantation potential and reduces the risk of genetic diseases.

Greater precision, better outcomes, and science-based decisions backed by cutting-edge genetics.

Unilab – Donor Screening and Testing with International Standards

We partner with Unilab, a specialized laboratory in donor screening and testing that complies with FDA regulations. This collaboration ensures that every donor evaluation is carried out under strict safety and quality protocols, which are essential for treatments involving donated gametes.

Trust and safety in every sample, with full regulatory compliance.

Cryotec – State-of-the-Art Vitrification Technology

We use Cryotec technology, a global leader in oocyte and embryo vitrification, known for its exceptionally high cell survival rates. This partnership allows us to offer our patients an ultra-rapid freezing method that maximizes gamete and embryo viability and quality.

Japanese precision technology to preserve your fertility with outstanding results.

Network of Partner Clinics in the U.S. and Canada

We are part of an international network of affiliated clinics across the United States and Canada, allowing patients to continue their fertility care seamlessly between countries. This collaboration facilitates the transportation of gametes and embryos, shared cycles, virtual consultations, and coordinated follow-ups.

Ongoing international care — without borders or interruptions.

Ferticare – Specialized Psychological Support

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we have an alliance with Ferticare, a team of specialists in fertility psychology, to offer emotional support throughout the reproductive journey.
Through this partnership, our patients receive professional guidance to help manage stress, anxiety, and the emotional challenges of fertility treatments.

We care for your physical and emotional well-being every step of the way.

International Sperm and Egg Banks – Global Options for Our Patients

Advanced Fertility Center Cancún maintains strategic alliances with internationally recognized sperm and egg banks, offering our patients a wide selection of safe, ethical, and reliable options for donor gametes.
Our partners include:

Xytex, Fairfax Cryobank, European Sperm Bank, Cryos International, among others.

These collaborations provide access to international donor catalogs, compliance with FDA, Health Canada, and European standards, and ensure the legal and secure importation of samples into Mexico.

Diversity, quality, and trust to build your family across borders.

Commitment to Quality and Trust

Every certification and alliance reflects our dedication to providing fertility treatments that meet the highest standards of quality and safety. At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, your well-being and treatment success are in the hands of a team supported by globally recognized institutions.

A path filled with generosity and love to help make the dream of parenthood come true.

Embryo donation and adoption is much more than a medical procedure; it is a hopeful opportunity for those dreaming of starting a family and facing difficulties conceiving with their own eggs or sperm.

This treatment offers the chance to give life to a new beginning through embryos donated by other couples who, with generosity and love, have chosen to share the most precious gift: the opportunity to become parents.
It is a journey that transforms lives and opens the door to hope, joy, and the miracle of motherhood or fatherhood when it once seemed out of reach.

Patients can choose to adopt an embryo and transfer it into the woman's body after
undergoing an endometrial preparation process 

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we passionately promote embryo donation as a beautiful way to help those who wish to fulfill their dream of becoming parents. We have a carefully organized catalog that allows future parents to make an informed and personalized selection of the embryo that best suits their needs and desires.

Our commitment is to accompany you with respect, ethics, and care at every stage of the process, providing you with security and confidence so that this journey toward motherhood or fatherhood is as special as possible.

Contact us now

Advantages of embryo donation and adoption

  • It allows people with complex reproductive challenges to achieve a successful pregnancy.
  • Use of already developed embryos, which can increase implantation and pregnancy rates.
  • It is an ethical and responsible option, giving a second chance to embryos that would otherwise be discarded.
  • Confidential process with professional support throughout the entire treatment.

Experts in fertility and assisted reproduction

Contact us now

A simple and natural method to support pregnancy during monitored cycles.

This is a low-complexity assisted reproduction treatment that requires monitoring the development of the dominant follicle using ultrasound during a natural female cycle (follicular monitoring). Certain medications can be used to stimulate the follicle and ensure ovulation at the right time.

Contact now Your doctor will tell you the ideal time to have sexual intercourse (coitus) at home to increase your chances of pregnancy.

Advantages of Timed Intercourse

  • It is a simple, non-invasive, and natural procedure.
  • Low cost compared to other fertility treatments.
  • Does not require hospitalization or surgical procedures.
  • Allows the couple to maintain intimacy and control throughout the process.
  • Can be combined with other ovarian stimulation techniques to improve results.

Who is Timed Intercourse recommended for?

  • Couples with mild infertility or unexplained infertility (idiopathic infertility).
  • Women with regular menstrual cycles but difficult-to-predict ovulation.
  • Couples who want to try a natural method before resorting to more complex treatments.

FERTILITY AND ASSISTED REPRODUCTION EXPERTS

Contact now

pages.post_content:
Una alternativa segura, accesible y confiable para quienes desean formar una familia.

La donación de esperma es una opción de reproducción asistida que permite lograr el embarazo mediante el uso de semen de un donante anónimo. Este tratamiento es ideal para mujeres solteras, parejas del mismo sexo o parejas heterosexuales con problemas severos de fertilidad masculina.

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún promovemos el acceso a esta alternativa con el mayor cuidado, confidencialidad y compromiso.

Banco de esperma nacional e internacional

Contamos con un banco de esperma cuidadosamente seleccionado que incluye donantes locales e internacionales. Todos los donantes son evaluados bajo estrictos protocolos médicos, genéticos y psicológicos, garantizando seguridad y calidad en cada muestra.

Además, tenemos convenios con bancos internacionales certificados para importar viales de donantes que cumplan con las características específicas que cada paciente busca, como grupo étnico, tipo de sangre, complexión física, nivel educativo, entre otros.

Experiencia en traslados internacionales

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún contamos con la experiencia y el equipo legal y logístico necesarios para realizar traslados internacionales de muestras de esperma con total cumplimiento de las regulaciones aduanales y sanitarias. Nos encargamos de todo el proceso, desde la solicitud del donante hasta la recepción y resguardo del material en nuestras instalaciones.

Contactar ahora

¿Para quién está indicada la donación de esperma?

  • Mujeres con baja o nula reserva ovárica.
  • Pacientes que han experimentado fallos repetidos de FIV.
  • Mujeres con menopausia prematura
  • Portadoras de enfermedades genéticas que podrían transmitir a su hijo.
  • Mujeres mayores de 40 años con baja calidad ovocitaria.
  • Parejas del mismo sexo o mujeres solteras que requieren tanto óvulo como esperma de donante.

Ventajas del tratamiento con donante de esperma:

  • Opción segura y confidencial.
  • Donantes seleccionados rigurosamente y previamente evaluados.
  • Posibilidad de elegir entre un amplio catálogo nacional e internacional.
  • Alta tasa de éxito cuando se combina con técnicas como Inseminación Intrauterina (IIU) o Fertilización In Vitro (FIV).

Nuestros bancos aliados de alto prestigio

Expertos en fertilidad y reproducción asistida

Contactar ahora

pages.post_content:
A safe, accessible, and reliable option for those who dream of building a family.

Sperm donation is a form of assisted reproduction that allows for pregnancy using semen from an anonymous donor. This treatment is ideal for single women, same-sex couples, or heterosexual couples facing severe male infertility.

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we offer this option with the utmost care, confidentiality, and commitment.

National and International Sperm Bank

We offer a carefully selected sperm bank that includes both local and international donors. All donors undergo thorough medical, genetic, and psychological screening to ensure the highest standards of safety and quality.
Additionally, we have partnerships with certified international sperm banks, which allow us to import vials from donors that meet your specific preferences—such as ethnicity, blood type, physical traits, educational background, and more.

Expertise in International Shipping

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we have the expertise and infrastructure to handle international shipments of donor sperm, ensuring full compliance with customs and health regulations. We manage the entire process—from donor selection to the secure arrival and storage of the sample at our facility.

Contactar ahora

Who can benefit from sperm donation?

  • Single women who wish to become mothers.
  • Parejas del mismo sexo o mujeres solteras que requieren tanto óvulo como esperma de donante.
  • Heterosexual couples with severe male infertility diagnoses.
  • Individuals looking to avoid transmitting hereditary genetic conditions.

Advantages of using donor sperm:

  • Safe and confidential process.
  • Rigorously screened and approved donors.
  • Access to a wide national and international catalog.
  • High success rates when combined with procedures like Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) or In Vitro Fertilization (IVF).

Our prestigious partner banks

Experts in fertility and assisted reproduction

Contact now

Una estrategia efectiva para pacientes con baja respuesta ovárica.

La doble acumulación es una técnica de reproducción asistida avanzada pensada especialmente para pacientes que presentan una baja reserva ovárica o que obtienen pocos óvulos en un ciclo de estimulación. Su objetivo es acumular ovocitos o embriones en dos (o más) ciclos consecutivos. Este enfoque innovador es particularmente beneficioso para pacientes con reserva ovárica disminuida, mujeres de edad materna avanzada o aquellas con planes de fertilidad urgentes (por ejemplo, antes de un tratamiento oncológico o de realizar un diagnóstico genético preimplantacional).

¿En qué consiste la doble acumulación?

En lugar de realizar una sola estimulación ovárica y proceder con la fertilización y transferencia, este protocolo permite realizar dos ciclos de estimulación seguidos sin esperar un ciclo menstrual completo entre ellos, extrayendo óvulos en ambas ocasiones y vitrificándolos o fecundándolos para luego transferir los embriones juntos en un solo intento.

Contactar ahora

¿Para quién está indicado?

  • Mujeres con baja respuesta ovárica.
  • Pacientes mayores de 37 años con poca cantidad de óvulos obtenidos en ciclos anteriores.
  • Personas que desean mejorar las probabilidades de éxito acumulando más embriones antes de la transferencia.
  • Pacientes que se van a realizar un estudio genético preimplantacional (PGT-A) y requieren un número suficiente de embriones.

Beneficios de la doble acumulación:

  • Aumenta la cantidad de embriones disponibles para transferencia.
  • Mejora las probabilidades de encontrar embriones euploides (con carga genética normal) en tratamientos con PGT-A.
  • Reduce el número de transferencias fallidas.
  • Permite un abordaje más personalizado y estratégico en pacientes con baja reserva ovárica.
  • Puede disminuir el estrés emocional y financiero, al optimizar los recursos en un proceso continuo.

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, evaluamos cuidadosamente cada caso para determinar si la estrategia de doble acumulación es la más adecuada. Nuestro equipo médico y de embriología está altamente capacitado para diseñar protocolos personalizados que maximicen tus posibilidades de éxito, siempre con el respaldo de tecnología de vanguardia y un enfoque humano y cercano.

Contactar ahora

pages.post_content:
A powerful protocol for maximizing egg retrieval in low-responder patients.

Double accumulation, back to back or Duo Stim is an advanced assisted reproduction technique designed especially for patients with low ovarian reserve or who retrieve a limited number of eggs in a single stimulation cycle. Its goal is to accumulate oocytes or embryos over two (or more) consecutive cycles. This innovative approach is particularly beneficial for patients with diminished ovarian reserve, women of advanced maternal age, or those with time-sensitive fertility plans (e.g., prior to cancer treatment or before undergoing Preimplantation Genetic Testing).

What does double accumulation involve?

Instead of performing one stimulation cycle followed by fertilization and embryo transfer, this protocol allows for two back-to-back ovarian stimulations—without waiting for a full menstrual cycle between them. Eggs retrieved from both cycles are then either vitrified or fertilized, and embryos are transferred together in a single attempt.

Contactar ahora

Who is it for?

  • Women with low ovarian response.
  • Patients over the age of 37 with few eggs retrieved in previous IVF cycles.
  • Individuals who want to improve their chances of success by accumulating more embryos before transfer.
  • Patients planning a Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT-A) and need a sufficient number of embryos for analysis.

Benefits of double accumulation:

  • Increases the number of embryos available for transfer.
  • Improves the chances of finding euploid embryos (with a normal chromosome count) in PGT-A cycles.
  • Reduces the risk of failed embryo transfers.
  • Offers a more strategic and personalized approach for low-responder patients.
  • May help reduce emotional and financial stress by optimizing the process for a single transfer.

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we carefully evaluate each case to determine whether double accumulation is the right strategy for you. Our team of medical specialists and embryologists is highly trained in designing customized protocols to maximize your chances of success—with state-of-the-art technology and compassionate care at every step of your journey.

Experts in fertility and assisted reproduction

pages.post_content:
Una forma única y especial de compartir la maternidad para todas las familias

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún apoyamos y celebramos la diversidad familiar, acompañando con respeto y calidez a todas las parejas, incluyendo a la comunidad LGBT+. El método ROPA (Recepción de Óvulos de la Pareja) es un tratamiento diseñado para parejas de mujeres que desean compartir biológicamente la experiencia de ser madres, fortaleciendo su vínculo a través de un camino lleno de amor y colaboración.

¿En qué consiste el método ROPA?

Este tratamiento de fertilización in vitro permite que una mujer aporte sus óvulos, que son fecundados en laboratorio con esperma de donante , y que su pareja lleve el embarazo, creando así una experiencia compartida y profundamente significativa. Ambas mujeres participan activamente en la maternidad, una como madre genética y la otra como madre gestante.

Contactar ahora

¿Para quién está indicado?

  • Parejas de mujeres que desean construir su familia compartiendo la maternidad biológica.
  • Mujeres que, por alguna razón, no pueden gestar pero quieren aportar sus óvulos.
  • Parejas que buscan una opción personalizada y respetuosa con sus deseos y valores.

Ventajas del método ROPA

  • Fortalece el vínculo familiar y emocional desde el inicio.
  • Alta tasa de éxito gracias a las técnicas avanzadas de fertilización in vitro.
  • Un proceso inclusivo, seguro y respetuoso con todas las identidades y formas de familia.
  • Permite a ambas mujeres ser parte activa de la experiencia de la maternidad.

Expertos en fertilidad y reproducción asistida

Contactar ahora

A unique and special way to share motherhood for all families

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we proudly support and celebrate family diversity, warmly and respectfully accompanying all couples, including the LGBT+ community. The ROPA method (Reception of Oocytes from Partner) is a treatment designed for female couples who wish to biologically share the experience of motherhood, strengthening their bond through a journey filled with love and collaboration.

What does the ROPA method involve?

This in vitro fertilization treatment allows one woman to provide her eggs, which are fertilized in the lab with donor sperm , and her partner carries the pregnancy, creating a shared and deeply meaningful experience. Both women actively participate in motherhood — one as the genetic mother and the other as the gestational mother.

Contact now

Who is it for?

  • Female couples who want to build their family by sharing biological motherhood.
  • Women who, for any reason, cannot carry a pregnancy but wish to provide their eggs.
  • Couples seeking a personalized and respectful option aligned with their wishes and values.

Advantages of the ROPA method

  • Strengthens the emotional and family bond from the very beginning.
  • High success rates thanks to advanced IVF techniques.
  • An inclusive, safe, and respectful process honoring all identities and family forms.
  • Allows both women to be active participants in the motherhood experience.

Experts in fertility and assisted reproduction

Contact now

pages.post_content:
En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún sabemos que cada paciente es único, por eso ofrecemos una variedad de tratamientos complementarios que pueden aumentar tus probabilidades de éxito y mejorar tu bienestar durante todo el proceso. Estos add-ons se integran de forma personalizada según tus necesidades médicas y emocionales.

Intralípidos

Una infusión diseñada para modular el sistema inmunológico, especialmente útil en pacientes con antecedentes de fallo recurrente de implantación o aborto espontáneo. Ayuda a reducir la inflamación y mejorar el ambiente uterino para favorecer la implantación embrionaria.

PRP (Plasma Rico en Plaquetas)

Terapia regenerativa que utiliza factores de crecimiento extraídos de tu propia sangre para mejorar la calidad del endometrio o estimular la función ovárica. Esta técnica puede ser beneficiosa en casos de baja respuesta ovárica o endometrios delgados.

Acupuntura

Una práctica milenaria que favorece la relajación, mejora la circulación sanguínea y equilibra el sistema hormonal. Muchos estudios sugieren que la acupuntura puede aumentar las tasas de implantación y disminuir el estrés durante los tratamientos de fertilidad.

Acompañamiento Emocional

Entendemos que la fertilidad puede ser un camino emocionalmente desafiante. Por eso, ofrecemos apoyo psicológico especializado durante todo el proceso, ayudándote a manejar la ansiedad, el estrés y fortaleciendo tu bienestar mental y emocional.

Embryo Glue

Un medio especial que se aplica durante la transferencia embrionaria para mejorar la adhesión del embrión al útero, aumentando las probabilidades de implantación y embarazo exitoso. Cada uno de estos complementos es evaluado y recomendado por nuestro equipo médico y coordinadores para asegurar que recibas la mejor atención personalizada, basada en la evidencia y con un enfoque humano y respetuoso. ¿Quieres saber cuáles add-ons pueden ser adecuados para ti? Agenda tu consulta con nosotros y déjanos acompañarte en cada paso hacia tu sueño de ser mamá o papá.

pages.post_content:
At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we understand that every patient is unique. That’s why we offer a variety of complementary treatments that can increase your chances of success and improve your well-being throughout the entire process. These add-ons are personalized to meet your specific medical and emotional needs.

Intralipids

An infusion designed to modulate the immune system, especially helpful for patients with a history of recurrent implantation failure or miscarriage. It helps reduce inflammation and improves the uterine environment to favor embryo implantation.

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma)

A regenerative therapy that uses growth factors extracted from your own blood to improve endometrial quality or stimulate ovarian function. This technique can be beneficial in cases of poor ovarian response or thin endometrium.

Acupuncture

An ancient practice that promotes relaxation, improves blood circulation, and balances the hormonal system. Many studies suggest that acupuncture can increase implantation rates and reduce stress during fertility treatments.

Emotional Support

We understand that fertility can be an emotionally challenging journey. That’s why we offer specialized psychological support throughout the entire process, helping you manage anxiety and stress while strengthening your mental and emotional well-being.

Embryo Glue

A special medium applied during embryo transfer to enhance the embryo’s adhesion to the uterus, increasing the chances of implantation and a successful pregnancy.

Each of these add-ons is carefully evaluated and recommended by our medical team and coordinators to ensure you receive the best personalized care, based on evidence and delivered with a compassionate and respectful approach.

Want to know which add-ons might be right for you? Schedule your consultation with us and let us support you every step of the way toward your dream of becoming a mom or dad.

Request a free video call

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we combine cutting-edge technology, a highly specialized medical team, and warm, inclusive care to help you achieve your dream of starting a family. With over 20 years of experience and excellent success rates, we offer personalized fertility treatments in top-tier facilities.

Because every family begins with a dream… and expert hands.

Why choose AFCC?

Cutting-edge Technology
IVF laboratories and operating rooms equipped with the latest advancements for your safety and success.

Excellent Success Rates
Effective, personalized treatments backed by real results.

Personalized Care
Receive human and close support at every step of your treatment.

Inclusion and Diversity
Single women and men, LGBT+ and heterosexual couples: all families are welcome. Modern, Well-Equipped Clinic
Spaces designed for your comfort, privacy, and well-being.

Bilingual Team
Bilingual assistance and full coordination for those traveling from abroad.

Everything in One Place
Diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up all in one location.

Learn more about us Book your appointment today

FREE ONLINE CONSULTATION!

Testimonials from our patients

https://youtu.be/z6Eks-CddSQ?si=_oPClMd1WTbeydTfhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sEnAw8w2G30%20 See all testimonials I started the process of freezing my eggs in the US and when I found out that it wasn’t covered by my insurance I started to think about what other options I have. I was also not impressed with the client service I was receiving from the clinic I was at, and I had heard that abroad they tend to treat the patients much better and the conditions are nicer. I was not disappointed! The minute I contacted the Fertility Center Cancun I was put in touch with Cynthia, who gave me all the information I needed and was always accessible and responsive via WhatsApp. Once I arrived at the clinic, I felt the same kind of care and attention from the entire staff, including Dr. Ray. He responded to all my many questions and was very responsive on WhatsApp, even after office hours, if I had a pressing concern. I did two cycles of egg freezing and I am very happy with the results! I am even considering another round, just in case. Ioana Luca USA Dr Suástegui I can not say it enough, Thank you for taking the best care of me. This was Exquisite Care as if i was Royal. You treated me like family not just a patient. I needed 2nd opinions and labs before my laparoscopy and you made sure I was treated fair by other nurses and doctors. I had a mishap at the pharmacy and my Dr showed up & even translated for me. I have never in all my life had a Doctor that went above and beyond to make sure I was ok and treated fair before during and after surgery. My husband could not make the trip but Dr Suástegui kept him informed every step of the way. Shon WuUSA I can't say enough good things about Dr. Cojab and her team at AFCC. My wife and I live in the U.S. and have gone through 2 failed surgeries on my end and a failed IVF FET cycle from The Reproductive Care Center in Salt Lake City. The clinic in SLC was the worst medical/ professional experience I've ever had, and we are still in dispute with them over several different problems. AFCC is the complete opposite. AFCC was terrific at communication, always there for questions, the Doctor maintained regular follow up months after we left and had a few scares, they were extremely patient and accommodating with the million questions we had, and most of all- they succeeded! We are now 12 weeks pregnant and entering the second trimester. We spent 3 years and $40k dealing with 3 doctors that were always too "busy", non-caring, and/ or incompetent (you can see a previous review on this clinic on my page); then we went to Mexico and got it done in a few months at half the cost of a normal cycle. They were honest and realistic with us, where the American doctors were always just watching out for medical malpractice and limiting the information, they would give us to protect themselves. We also have 2 more embryos that AFCC was able to freeze, so we will likely be back in a year. The vacation in Cancun was a little bonus as well haha. I 100% recommend this clinic. Austin UTAH - USA BEST PLACE EVER! They make your dreams come true! I’m a travel patient Im from Idaho and I recommend Dr Alfonso ❤️ I had best experience and great communication with Elizabeth. Just remember IVF is a process is a journey forsure. Keep positive and everything you dream of will come true.

I highly recommend and will be having all my IVF babies here at AFCC forsure! Amy Gutierrez GARDEN CITY We had our two children with the help of the Fertility Center, Cancun and we cannot praise them enough. They are incredibly professional, the doctors are just unbelievable and their staff goes out of their way to make you feel comfortable and help you through your stay in Cancun. We hear from other people trying for years with other providers, we were successful within months and had our babies nine months afterwards without any problems thanks to their incredible professionalism and facilities. Alex USA We had our two children with the help of the Fertility Center, Cancun and we cannot praise them enough. They are incredibly professional, the doctors are just unbelievable and their staff goes out of their way to make you feel comfortable and help you through your stay in Cancun. We hear from other people trying for years with other providers, we were successful within months and had our babies nine months afterwards without any problems thanks to their incredible professionalism and facilities. Leon Avelino USA AFCC is so amazing! The staff is so friendly, the clinic very clean. Communication was great! Any questions or concerns I had were addressed, they really listened to me. Dr Romero is so caring and knowledgeable, and Eli has to be the sweetest and most helpful person on the planet! Because of AFCC I have my 2 most beautiful & perfect babies. I would tell anyone looking for a fertility clinic to choose them. I was able to bring my daughter back to meet everyone, and I can’t wait to bring my son back and do the same! I’m forever grateful. Brenda Breitkreutz The Fertility Center allowed for something I didn't think would be possible, we had our baby. Everyone at this facility made the process so smooth for us. They treated us like family! Elizabeth made sure we had everything logistically taken care of, and Dr. Romero has always made sure we were physically and emotionally prepared for the entire process. We would recommend the Center to anyone who has been trying to have their baby. You will be in the hands of the best of the best! D W Florida

pages.post_content:
Tu recomendación no solo tiene recompensa, también puede cambiar vidas. Ayúdanos a llevar esperanza a más familias.

¡Comparte tu experiencia y recibe beneficios exclusivos!

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, agradecemos la confianza de nuestros pacientes. Por eso, hemos creado un programa de referidos especialmente pensado para ti:

¿Qué beneficios puedes obtener?

1 año de almacenamiento gratuito

Aplica para embriones, óvulos o viales. Válido si la persona referida inicia tratamiento con nosotros.

Descuento en tu anualidad de almacenamiento

Por cada persona que agende una videollamada de cortesía gracias a tu recomendación.

¿Cómo funciona?

  1. Comparte tu experiencia con amigos, familiares o personas que podrían beneficiarse de nuestros tratamientos.

pages.post_content:
Your referral doesn’t just earn rewards — it can change lives. Help us bring hope to more families.

Share your experience and receive exclusive benefits!

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we’re grateful for the trust our patients place in us. That’s why we’ve created a special referral program just for you:

What can you earn?

1 year of free storage

Applies to embryos, eggs, or vials. Valid when the referred person begins treatment with us.

Discount on your annual storage fee

For every person who schedules a complimentary video consultation through your recommendation.

How does it work?

  1. Share your experience with friends, family, or anyone who could benefit from our care.
  2. You can refer them in two ways:
    1. By sharing the contact information of your assigned patient care executive.
    2. Or by sending an email to: info@fertilitycentermexico.com.mx
  3. Make sure they mention your full name when booking.
  4. You’ll receive your reward once their video consultation or treatment is confirmed.

Available for international patients too!

Fertility and Assisted Reproduction Specialists

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, we are proud to have a multidisciplinary team of experts in fertility and assisted reproduction, fully committed to helping you fulfill your dream of building a family.

Our team — including gynecologists, embryologists, nurses, anesthesiologists, and patient care staff — is highly qualified and trained at some of the world’s leading institutions. We work together to provide you with an accurate diagnosis and a treatment plan tailored to your unique needs, always with a professional and compassionate approach.

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancún, your well-being and the success of your treatment are our top priorities!

pages.post_content:
Español English

Diosa Ixchel – Inspiración y Fertilidad en Cancún

En Advanced Fertility Center Cancún honramos la energía milenaria de Ixchel, la diosa maya de la fertilidad, la sanación y la esperanza.

Según la tradición, Ixchel habitaba en la isla de Cozumel, donde las mujeres mayas peregrinaban para pedir el don de la vida. Hoy, su presencia en nuestra recepción simboliza que ciencia, fe y fuerza femenina pueden unirse para hacer realidad el sueño de la maternidad.

El legado de Ixchel
En el santuario maya de San Gervasio ubicado en la hermosa Isla de Cozumel en donde miles de mujeres acudían para recibir su bendición. Su imagen trascendió como uno de los símbolos sagrados más poderosos del mundo prehispánico.

Representada con la luna, el agua y el telar, Ixchel es conocida como “la tejedora de la vida”, protectora de los nacimientos y de quienes buscan crear una familia.

Significado de su símbolo

  • La Luna: guía de los ciclos femeninos, fertilidad y renacimiento.
  • El cántaro de agua: abundancia, sanación y nuevos comienzos.
  • La serpiente: sabiduría, transformación y renovación.
  • El telar de hilos: la vida se teje con amor y paciencia, como el sueño de la familia.
  • Flores y maíz: prosperidad, crecimiento y alimento sagrado de la maternidad.

Ixchel en tu viaje de fertilidad

En la cosmovisión maya, Ixchel acompaña a las mujeres en su camino hacia la vida. La leyenda cuenta que quienes se acercan a ella reciben claridad, paz y confianza en su proceso.

Y si tu corazón lo desea, siempre podrás viajar a Cozumel y visitar su santuario, donde desde tiempos ancestrales mujeres y familias han pedido lo mismo que hoy te acompaña: el milagro de la vida.

Goddess Ixchel – Inspiration and Fertility in Cancun

At Advanced Fertility Center Cancun, we honor the ancient energy of Ixchel, the Mayan goddess of fertility, healing, and hope.

According to tradition, Ixchel lived on the island of Cozumel, where Mayan women made pilgrimages to pray for the gift of life. Today, her presence at our reception symbolizes that science, faith, and feminine strength can unite to make the dream of motherhood a reality.

Ixchel’s Legacy
At the Mayan sanctuary of San Gervasio, located on the beautiful island of Cozumel, thousands of women came to receive her blessing. Her image has transcended as one of the most powerful sacred symbols of the pre-Hispanic world.

Represented by the moon, water, and the loom, Ixchel is known as “the weaver of life,” protector of births and of those seeking to start a family.

Meaning of Her Symbol

  • The Moon: guide of feminine cycles, fertility, and rebirth.
  • The water pitcher: abundance, healing, and new beginnings.
  • The serpent: wisdom, transformation, and renewal.
  • The loom of threads: life is woven with love and patience, like the dream of family.
  • Flowers and corn: prosperity, growth, and the sacred nourishment of motherhood.

 

Ixchel on Your Fertility Journey

In the Mayan worldview, Ixchel accompanies women on their journey toward life. Legend has it that those who approach her receive clarity, peace, and confidence in their process.

And if your heart desires, you can always travel to Cozumel and visit her sanctuary, where since ancient times women and families have asked for the same thing that accompanies you today: the miracle of life.
